title: FL1GHT Network
description: A semi-survival server with a player-driven economy, shops, parkour, crates & events. Java + Bedrock welcome via Geyser. 1.21.11+ with ViaVersion.
body:
**Welcome to the _FL1GHT Network_!**

A laid-back semi-survival server where you actually have room to breathe.
FL1GHT Network is a community-first Minecraft server built for players who want more than just vanilla, without the chaos of a hardcore grind. Whether you're here to build, trade, compete, or just hang out, there's a place for you.

✨ _What you'll find here_

A living economy. Set up shop in our player shopping district, sell what you gather, and build your fortune. Our economy is player-driven — prices rise and fall based on what the community actually does.
Semi-survival, done right. Explore, build, and settle in with land protection so your hard work stays yours. A central hub ties everything together, with NPCs to guide you and leaderboards to track who's on top.
Custom features to keep things fresh. Test your skills on our parkour courses, try your luck with crates and the server lottery, and climb the leaderboards across the stats we track. There's always something to chase.
Events & a real community. We're a welcoming bunch. Jump into community events, meet other players, and settle in — whether you're a builder, a grinder, a trader, or just here to vibe.

🎮 _How to join_

Java + Bedrock, both welcome! Thanks to Geyser, you can join from either edition — bring your friends no matter what they play on.

**Server IP**: 
  **Java**: _mc.fl1ght.network_
  **Bedrock**: _play.fl1ght.network:1083_

**Version support**: Runs current Minecraft with ViaVersion, so you can connect on **1.21.11 and beyond** without version headaches.

💬 _Join the community_
Hop into our Discord to chat, get updates, join events, and get help: **discord.gg/QHVU9J2whb**
